# Shantanu Dutta

.NET Full Stack Developer (C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core,
SQL Server, Angular, React) with 4+ years building enterprise web apps.
Based in Surat, Gujarat, India.

## Currently

Full Stack Developer at ProjectTree (December 2022 - present). Mostly
backend work: designing REST APIs, tuning SQL Server queries and securing
applications, with Angular and React front ends.

- Cut API response times by 40% through SQL Server query refactoring and
  Redis caching
- Built an Event Registration System (real-time seat availability, payment
  integration), an Event Management Platform, an internal HelpDesk with
  RBAC, ticket routing and SLA tracking, and automated Leave Management
  approval workflows
- JWT authentication and role-based authorization across production apps
- CI/CD with Jenkins and Azure DevOps; secrets management with HashiCorp Vault
- Mentor junior developers through code reviews and pair programming

## Skills

- Backend: C#, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework

- Frontend: Angular, React, Redux, TypeScript, RxJS, Reactive Forms, Angular

- Engineering: Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, HashiCorp Vault, Docker,
  Jasmine/Karma, OOP, SOLID, Agile/Scrum

## What sets me apart

- Backend-first, but ships production front ends in both Angular and React

- Performance measured, not guessed: 40% faster APIs from SQL Server query

- AI-assisted development as an everyday workflow (Claude Code certified)
- Mentors junior developers through code reviews and pair programming
